prompt: How many products have two price windows that overlap? This table may hold errors. A product's price windows should never overlap. A window runs from valid_from to valid_to, both days included, and a missing valid_to means the window is still open. Two windows of one product overlap when they share at least one day. Return one column, n_products. The result is a single row. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, pair each window with the later windows of the same product.
A later window overlaps when it starts on or before the day the earlier one ends; both end days count, so the test keeps the equal day.
why_this_works: Each window meets only the later windows of its product, and one that starts on or before the earlier end shares at least that day.
